title: Choose Lumio’s visual direction
question: Which visual world should guide Lumio’s investigation chat?

options.label: Registered Post
options.thesis: A scan travels through clear checkpoints, then returns as an evidence receipt.
options.viewport: A familiar chat thread carries one investigation, its live progress, and the results that arrive.
options.risk: The delivery metaphor must stay subtle; this is security analysis, not parcel tracking.

raised.raise: Keep one active investigation visually dominant; never split the work into competing panels.
Use a clear type ladder for conversation, evidence titles, and technical values.
Show the current step and waiting steps with distinct, plainly labeled states.
Keep every status readable as words; do not encode meaning in color alone.
Pair state color with a text label and an icon so evidence remains clear in any lighting.

options.label: Support Conversation
options.thesis: Lumio guides each person through a check in a familiar conversation.
options.viewport: A conversational thread makes it easy to submit a link or email and follow the result.
options.risk: The familiar pattern may feel like a generic assistant without evidence-specific details.

options.label: Grid-Bound Evidence
options.thesis: A visible grid connects each scan step to the evidence it produced.
options.viewport: The chat remains standard; a restrained grid marks progress and aligns each evidence note.
options.case: Holds product clarity by mapping steps to evidence; the register is less familiar to general users.
options.risk: Keep the grid out of long reading text and never let it resemble a technical console.

options.label: Vertical Media
options.thesis: One item fills the screen while actions line a vertical rail.
options.case: Does not carry a multi-step investigation or an evidence report.
options.kept: Keep one active investigation visually dominant.

options.label: Bitmap Specimen
options.thesis: Pixel-built letterforms turn a type specimen into the main event.
options.case: Display lettering would compete with reading detailed findings.
options.kept: Give conversation, evidence, and technical values distinct type roles.

options.label: Manual Tabs
options.thesis: Layered translucent leaves expose one selected reference at a time.
options.case: Its page-and-tab model makes the conversation harder to follow.
options.kept: Make current, waiting, and finished scan steps easy to tell apart.

options.label: Catalog Sleeve
options.thesis: A coded color strip reveals a catalog entry’s identity.
options.case: Encoded labels add work to a task that needs plain language.
options.kept: Use consistent labels for every progress and report state.

options.label: Exposure Record
options.thesis: Overlaid tonal sheets show measured changes and conflicts.
options.case: The exposure scale has no familiar meaning for this audience.
options.kept: Pair status color with labels and symbols.

canonCard.label: Familiar Chat App
canonCard.thesis: A standard chat interface, executed to the highest craft.
canonCard.viewport: The expected chat layout with a clear composer, readable messages, and a visible scan report.
canonCard.risk: Familiar and direct, but easy to confuse with other chat tools.
